sources.title: PP-DocLayoutV3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PP-DocLayoutV3 is a unified and high-efficiency model designed for comprehensive layout analysis. It addresses the challenges of complex physical distortions—such as skewing, curving, and adverse lighting—by integrating instance segmentation and reading order prediction into a single, end-to-end framework.
